$ARGUMENTS

Stopping condition for hrb_chatbot_v2 (a Python/FastAPI RAG project whose standing rules - 'flag don't fix', 'one task at a time' - are tracked in CLAUDE.md and docs/RAG-ROADMAP.md): last_assistant_message above describes writing or changing Python code under src/ or tests/, AND the message text itself clearly states at least one of - (a) tests were skipped, not run, or deferred; (b) an unresolved TODO/FIXME/placeholder that the message itself calls out; (c) something is claimed done/complete/working while that same message also describes a known failure or an unverified assumption. Do not guess at anything the message doesn't state. Plain documentation/config changes, research, questions, and a task whose own description includes verification do not satisfy this condition. Deny if this condition is satisfied, quoting the specific unverified claim as the reason; otherwise allow.
